Enum FaceAction

com.hiface.sdk.flow.FaceAction
All Implemented Interfaces:
java.io.Serializable, java.lang.Comparable<FaceAction>
public enum FaceAction extends java.lang.Enum<FaceAction>
Supported action-liveness challenges. The host specifies their order through FaceLivenessConfig.

  • Enum Constant Summary

    Enum Constants
    Enum Constant
    Description
    BLINK
    Either eye completes an open, closed, then reopened sequence in the required order.
    MOUTH_OPEN
    Detect a closed-mouth state followed by a clearly open mouth.
    NOD_HEAD
    Detect a sufficiently large up/down change in head angle.
    SHAKE_HEAD
    Detect head-angle changes in both left and right directions.

    • NOD_HEAD

      public static final FaceAction NOD_HEAD
